scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env PV_DESKTOP_DEV=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs ."
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.desktop:all: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --win --x64
